artifacts.boundary: Classifies mesh-neighbor capabilities from bounded local signals; it does not establish identity or permanent trust.
Records opaque local state commitments; it does not establish personhood or publish personal data.
Classifies device-specific EMC margin observations; it does not assess human exposure safety.
Pauses noncritical software work under configured environmental conditions; it does not command physical movement.
Accounts for externally characterized bench energy samples; it does not authorize energy transfer near people.
Computes a unitless workload-cost index; it does not estimate physiology or medical status.
Evaluates supplied gate records; it does not certify scientific truth, safety, or legal compliance.
Evaluates purpose-bound consent metadata; it is not a standalone endpoint confidentiality boundary.
Checks policy-defined review quorum records; it does not create legal authority or reviewer neutrality.
Defines the shape of metadata-only tier 3 eligibility records; it does not verify brain-bound identity or personhood.
Defines exportable metadata-only decision receipts; it documents procedure and grants no legal standing.
Constrains anchor manifests to opaque digests; it never carries personal data or plaintext state.
Shapes aggregate metric claims pending external review; it does not certify scientific truth.
Ledgers evidence by digest and consent epoch; it stores no signals and assesses no clinical safety or efficacy.
Records gate outcomes for research-stage advancement; it certifies neither safety nor legal compliance.
Binds a purpose set and epoch to consent metadata; it proves procedure followed, not identity of the subject.
Advances the revocation epoch to block future cooperative use; it cannot recall prior disclosure.
Declares adjacency, bounds, budgets, and release checks for corridor aggregation; differential privacy here is a disclosure control, not anonymization.
Orders release checks before publication; passing them authorizes review, not deployment or safety.
Assigns default storage and disclosure posture per data class; it evaluates metadata and does not prove endpoint confidentiality.
Governs local anchoring bookkeeping over opaque digests; it demonstrates commitment ordering, not identity or tamper resistance.
Contracts localhost hub metadata exchange; it implies no remote service availability or regulatory approval.
Serves procedural rights metadata locally; serving documents grants no legal rights or citizen-status determination.
Records the locally adopted amendment procedure for safety clauses; it creates no legal authority outside the adopting context.
Enumerates declared reviewer membership and independence attestations; declarations are procedural and require external verification for neutrality.
Maps declared continuity-state transitions over opaque references; it does not prove continuity of experience or identity.
Bounds prompt-continuity context by digest and epoch; it embeds no prompt text and prevents no already-exported disclosure.
Rules for merging continuity records without silent drops; it adjudicates bookkeeping, not truth or legal status.
Describes the local sovereignty-preservation mechanism set and its boundaries; it confers no rights or approvals.
Specifies metadata-only claim requirements; claim acceptance remains procedural and externally reviewable.
Authenticates requests against policy metadata, not persons; attestation digests are advisory integrity hints only.
Enumerates assumed adversaries for local neural-data governance; it is analysis, not a security certification.
Layers declared mitigations over the threat model; layering reduces exposure but does not prove endpoint security.
Builds and validates metadata-only decision receipts in-process; it performs no file, network, or sensor access.
Gates procedural entitlements on epoch, purpose, and class metadata; it authenticates procedure, not people.
Creates metadata-only eligibility audit tables with opaque references; it stores no signals, biometrics, or payloads.
Creates aggregate claim ledger tables referencing digests; it stores no row-level observations or location traces.
Creates consent-event and access-audit tables over epochs and opaque references; audit rows are minimal metadata, not content.
Inventories wired artifacts and their runtime boundaries; the manifest declares posture and makes no security, legal, or clinical claims.

non_claims: No artifact verifies brain-bound identity or personhood.
No artifact grants legal rights, clinical status, or regulatory approval.
Local-first processing reduces remote exposure but does not prove endpoint security.
Revocation prevents future cooperative use but cannot recall prior disclosure.
Differential privacy is a disclosure control, not anonymization.
Oversight records are procedural and require an adopted enforcement context.
integration_order: Load data classification and consent policy.
Validate current consent epoch before sensitive processing.
Keep sensitive source and derived artifacts in local-only storage.
Use evidence gates before advancing research stage.
Require oversight quorum for policy-defined high-impact actions.
Apply aggregation, release checks, and privacy accounting before corridor publication.
Record minimal audit metadata and exportable decision receipts.

validation.guarantees: Validation confirms that listed artifacts exist at repository-relative paths, that JSON artifacts parse, that the inventory is complete, and that boundary statements are present.
